in_marathi.name: Samaira
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Samaira हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Samaira is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘समयारा’ (samayara), which means 'Goddess of Prosperity'. It is believed that this name bestows wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Samaira is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth and fortune.
